scripts.build: pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile --unsafe-perm --config.enable-pre-post-scripts=true --config.allow-builds=* && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.mobile:add:ios: pnpm run app:build && cap add ios
scripts.mobile:sync: pnpm run app:build && cap sync ios
